levels.A1: I get the basics of everyday life
levels.B2: I’m comfortable on a range of topics

common.appDescription: One language session a day, at your own pace.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: One language session a day, at your own pace.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Your progress is saved and follows you across your devices.
signUp.checkEmail: Check your inbox: we just sent a confirmation link to {email}.
signUp.confirmed: Email confirmed. You can sign in now.

guest.banner: You’re trying Daily Lingua without an account. Create one whenever you like to keep your progress.

passwordReset.title: Forgot your password?
passwordReset.intro: Enter your email address and we’ll send you a link to choose a new one.
passwordReset.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a link is on its way.

signOut.confirm: You’ll be signed out of this device. Your progress stays saved.

native.title: Your native language
native.hint: We use it to explain things in the language you understand best.

level.title: Where you’re starting from
level.hint: A rough guess is fine: the app adjusts as you go.

time.title: Your time each day
time.hint: You can change it whenever you like.
time.option: {count, plural, one {# minute a day} other {# minutes a day}}

goal.caption: One session is enough to close the ring.
goal.label: Today’s goal

session.duration: {count, plural, one {# minute, step by step.} other {# minutes, step by step.}}
session.nothingToChoose: Nothing to pick to get going.

interfaceLanguage.label: Interface language
interfaceLanguage.hint: The app’s text appears in this language.

nativeLanguage.label: Native language
nativeLanguage.hint: Explanations and translations follow this language.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.hint: Your study day rolls over at 4 a.m. in this time zone.

reminder.label: Reminder time
reminder.hint: One reminder a day, never at night.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: Light, dark, or follow your phone.

account.guest: You’re using Daily Lingua without an account.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: No connection right now. Your answers are kept on this device.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.invalid: Some of the information isn’t valid. Check it and try again.
errors.conflict: This information changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
errors.notFound: We can’t find what you’re looking for.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
errors.linkExpired: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
errors.emailInvalid: That email address doesn’t look valid.
errors.emailTaken: An account already exists with this address. Sign in instead.
errors.passwordWeak: That password is too weak. Pick a longer or more varied one.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.botCheckLoad: The bot check couldn’t load. Reload the page.
errors.guestUnavailable: Trying without an account isn’t available right now.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: This page needs the internet. Your answers stay on this device and are sent as soon as the network is back.

lab.title: Test tools
lab.intro: This page checks, on your phone, what the browser can do: microphone, voice, notifications, offline. No recording is sent and nothing is kept on the server.
lab.closedHint: Tap a card to open it.

environment.title: Installation and storage
environment.hint: Checks whether the app was opened from the home screen and how much room the browser gives it.
environment.swRegistered: registered, not controlling this page yet

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.hint: Records 5 seconds, then plays them back here.
microphone.privacy: The recording stays on this device: it is sent nowhere.
microphone.denied: The microphone is denied: allow it in the browser or app settings.

voices.title: Speech voices
voices.hint: Lists the voices for {language} and reads a trial sentence.
voices.unsupported: This browser has no speech synthesis.
voices.noVoice: No voice for this language: the browser’s default voice is used.

recognition.title: Speech recognition
recognition.hint: Tap the button, then say a sentence in {language}.
recognition.unsupported: This browser has no speech recognition.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.hint: Asks for permission, subscribes this device to Web Push and receives a trial notification.
notifications.swMissing: missing (the service worker only runs in the production build)
notifications.subscriptionNote: The subscription is shown here only: it is stored nowhere.
notifications.noKey: No VAPID public key: only the permission is tested.
notifications.unsupported: This browser has no notifications. On iPhone, install the app on the home screen first.
notifications.pushDisabled: sending is off on the server (no private key)

queue.title: Offline mode
queue.hint: Queue 3 events, cut the network (airplane mode), then restore it: they leave on their own. Sending is a stand-in: nothing leaves the device.
queue.unsupported: This browser has no IndexedDB: the queue cannot be kept.
queue.logQueued: {count, plural, one {# event queued} other {# events queued}}
queue.logSent: {count, plural, one {# event sent} other {# events sent}}
